purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed reference data on individual aircraft (tail number, manufacturer, model, engine configuration, and capacity) to support joins with flight-event fact tables for analyses such as fleet composition, aircraft age, or capacity-weighted metrics.
usage: Join on tailnum, the declared grain key which is unique and non-null across all 3322 rows. Expect null values in year (about 2.1% missing) and especially in speed (over 99% missing), so aggregations over those columns should explicitly handle nulls rather than assume full coverage.
limitations: The speed column is retained despite being populated for less than 1% of rows and should not be relied upon for broad analysis without accounting for this sparsity. Three Airbyte capture-metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped as non-business artifacts. No duplicate rows were found in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no dedupe logic was applied.
